scope_label: Kingdom of Denmark — source-first national honours directory batch

files_checked: No earlier Denmark volume, candidate, checkpoint or image manifest found in data/volumes; image_manifest.json showed no Denmark batch.

existing_coverage.deduplication: No existing Denmark volume found; family-level cross-check against data/volumes and global volume names remains required by parent before site merge.

sources.source_name: Medals of the World — Denmark ribbon charts and linked object pages
sources.date_coverage: Medal establishment dates and service-period clues as stated on individual catalogue pages
sources.content_coverage: 53 linked detail pages from two ribbon-chart indexes fetched and cached; 35 image-bearing page candidates; 28 complete images downloaded and decoded; other candidates remain raw/unpictured.
sources.image_quality_notes: The selected original directory images are complete page-embedded object drawings/illustrations or photos; visual medium is marked per dimensions and remains subject to visual review; small originals are explicitly low-resolution.
sources.download_method: Two ribbon-chart pages followed to all linked denmarkNNN.htm detail pages; direct original image paths downloaded from the same site with rate-limited sequential requests.
sources.rights_note: No per-image license statement found on the catalogue pages. Keep local for research only pending rights review.

sources.source_name: Kongehuset — Danish decorations in order of precedence
sources.date_coverage: Institution, approval and service-eligibility dates for royal, public, military and approved decorations
sources.content_coverage: Official list opened and checked for grade descriptions and dates. It supports a selection of award identities but does not constitute a full historical directory.
sources.image_quality_notes: No image batch collected from this source.
sources.download_method: Official web page opened and relevant sections reviewed.
sources.rights_note: Official facts page; no image rights implicated.

sources.source_name: Orders, decorations, and medals of Denmark; Wikimedia Commons Denmark medal categories
sources.date_coverage: Historical and current award family discovery
sources.content_coverage: English main table opened; Commons Medals of Denmark category lists 33 subcategories and 66 direct files; 17 subcategory pages were opened for triage. Commons API returned HTTP 429 and was stopped. No Commons image files were added in this batch.
sources.image_quality_notes: Several direct files are low-resolution schematic illustrations; many subcategories contain unrelated historical commemorative pieces. They are not counted in this batch.
sources.download_method: Public category pages via browser; direct image API was unavailable due to 429.
sources.local_cache: Web access only; category names/counts recorded in checkpoint.
sources.rights_note: Per-file rights must be checked on each Commons object page before any reuse.
